# Erickson Coaching International

> ICF-accredited professional coach training and certification programs grounded in solution-focused methodology and the legacy of Milton Erickson.

Erickson Coaching International offers comprehensive coach training from foundational to advanced credentials (PCC, MCC), specialized programs in team coaching, NLP, and the Enneagram, plus enterprise organizational coaching services. The institution serves aspiring and experienced coaches worldwide through online and onsite training locations.

## Key Topics

- ICF Accreditation
- Coach Certification
- Solution-Focused Coaching
- The Art & Science of Coaching
- Professional Development
- Team Coaching
- NLP Practitioner
- MCC Credential
- Leadership Development
- Executive Coaching

- Organizational Coaching

- Coach Training Courses
- Coaching Education

## Core Coach Training Programs

- [The Art & Science of Coaching](https://www.erickson.edu/en/the-art-and-science-of-coaching): Foundational ICF-accredited coaching program with solution-focused methodology
- [The Art & Science of Coaching - Level 3 (The MCC Journey)](https://www.erickson.edu/en/the-art-science-of-coaching-level-3-the-mcc-journey): Advanced MCC credential course for PCC-credentialed coaches pursuing mastery
- [High Performance Team Coaching](https://www.erickson.edu/en/high-performance-team-coaching): ICF-accredited team coaching certification with ACTC pathway
- [NLP Practitioner Certification](https://www.erickson.edu/en/nlp-practitioner-certification): NLP Practitioner Certification with ICF CCEUs and advanced coaching techniques
- [Deep Coaching Certification](https://www.erickson.edu/en/deep-coaching): Exploration of consciousness and coach mastery for experienced practitioners
- [Light of the Enneagram](https://www.erickson.edu/en/light-of-the-enneagram): Enneagram-based coach training for personality type exploration and coaching

## Specialized Training & Services

- [International Trainer's Training](https://www.erickson.edu/en/the-international-trainers-training): Train-the-trainer certification covering presentation and course design skills
- [Solution-Focused Organizational Coaching Services](https://www.erickson.edu/organizationalcoaching): Enterprise coaching services for Fortune 500 companies and large organizations
- [Become a Coach - Career Guidance](https://www.erickson.edu/coaching-careers): Professional coaching career paths and specialization guidance
- [Onsite Training Worldwide](https://www.erickson.edu/en/on-site-training-worldwide): In-person training locations including Paris, Amsterdam, Berlin, and other global cities

## Program Discovery & Enrollment

- [Program Finder](https://programfinder.erickson.edu): Interactive tool for course search and coaching pathway selection
- [Program Pricing](https://www.erickson.edu/en/pricing): Comprehensive pricing with financial and youth subsidies available
- [Upcoming Webinars & Events](https://www.erickson.edu/en/upcoming-webinars): Register for online events and webinars featuring world-class coaches

## Community & Continuing Education

- [Erickson+ Alumni Community](https://www.erickson.edu/en/erickson-plus): Alumni app for continuing education, networking, and coaching journey advancement
- [Erickson's World Game](https://www.erickson.edu/lets-play-the-world-game): Global coaching conference and event for social impact and professional development
- [Resources](https://www.erickson.edu/resources): Learning materials including ICF competencies and coaching resources
